fields.statement: Re-verified at ef87fc35 (attempt 2). The fix commit only changes the leaf statement, so it now says the README links the quickstart and the MIT LICENSE and names the concepts, agents and reference pages as coming. README.md matches that: what Rhiza is and why in three paragraphs, install by go install or release binaries, a [quickstart](docs/quickstart.md) link, the other pages named as 'on the way', and [MIT](LICENSE). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/doclinks/... passes, including TestRepoDocsLinksResolve over README.md and docs/ (docs-links-resolve). The prose reads natural, with no em dashes or stock LLM phrasing (doc-prose-humanized). make self-check prints ok in a clean worktree at HEAD. Owner sign-off is left to the run's signoff stage.
